summary: GoldMining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) attaching a November 5, 2026 news release announcing operational progress at its 100%-owned São Jorge gold project in Pará, Brazil. The company engaged SLR Consulting to lead pre-feasibility study engineering and metallurgy and CLAM Environmental to conduct environmental and socioeconomic baseline studies supporting the EIA/RIMA permitting process. Three diamond rigs are advancing a planned 6,000-metre infill program, with over 1,000 metres drilled. No transaction terms, securities, or capital events are involved; a routine operational disclosure.
